rows.label: Population
rows.definition: The ACS estimate counts residents at this place during the 2020–2024 survey period. It is a population count, not a population density or growth rate.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

rows.label: Median age
rows.definition: The ACS estimates the age at the midpoint of the population at this place during 2020–2024. Half the population is younger than this age and half is older.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

rows.label: Men per 100 women
rows.definition: Men divided by women, multiplied by 100. Values below 100 mean fewer men than women.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

rows.label: Hispanic or Latino share
rows.definition: Hispanic or Latino residents divided by all residents, multiplied by 100. This is the share of the total population that is Hispanic or Latino; Hispanic origin can be of any race.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

rows.label: Asian non-Hispanic share
rows.definition: People who are Asian alone and not Hispanic or Latino divided by all residents, multiplied by 100. This is the share of the total population in that category.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

rows.label: Black non-Hispanic share
rows.definition: People who are Black or African American alone and not Hispanic or Latino divided by all residents, multiplied by 100. This is the share of the total population in that category.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

rows.label: White non-Hispanic share
rows.definition: People who are White alone and not Hispanic or Latino divided by all residents, multiplied by 100. This is the share of the total population in that category.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

rows.label: Foreign-born share
rows.definition: Residents born outside the United States divided by all residents, multiplied by 100. This is the share of the population that is foreign-born.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

rows.label: Share of residents who are not U.S. citizens
rows.definition: Non-citizen residents divided by total residents, multiplied by 100.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

rows.label: Median household income
rows.definition: The ACS estimates the midpoint of household incomes at this place over 2020–2024: half of households had a higher income and half had a lower income. This is a household measure, not income per person.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

rows.label: Average income per person
rows.definition: Total income in the past 12 months divided by the total population. This is the average dollar income per person, not a household income figure.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

rows.label: Median monthly rent
rows.definition: The ACS estimates the midpoint of monthly gross rents for renter-occupied homes paying cash rent. Half of these rents are higher and half are lower.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.

rows.label: Median home value
rows.definition: The ACS estimates the midpoint of reported home values for owner-occupied homes. Half of the estimated values are higher and half are lower.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.

rows.label: Median monthly owner costs
rows.definition: The ACS estimates selected monthly costs for owner-occupied homes, including housing expenses such as mortgage payments, taxes, insurance, utilities, and fuels. This is a housing-cost measure, not a home price.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.
Keep ACS shares based on same-release ACS numerators and denominators; annual PEP denominators are not substitutes for ACS share denominators.

rows.label: Share of renters spending 30%+ of income on rent
rows.definition: Renters spending 30 percent or more of household income on rent divided by renter households with a computable ratio, multiplied by 100.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.

rows.label: Homeownership rate

limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.

rows.label: Poverty rate
rows.definition: People whose income is below the Census poverty threshold divided by the population for whom poverty status is determined, multiplied by 100. It is the share of that population below the threshold; it is not a measure of how far below it their incomes are.
limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.

limitations: The 2025 ACS 1-year schedule is October 29, 2026, after this review date, and covers areas of 65,000+; the 2025 ACS 5-year date is TBD.

rows.label: Cost of living index

rows.label: New cancer cases per 100,000 residents
rows.definition: State cancer case count divided by 2024 state population, multiplied by 100,000. The US value uses the national count and population. No county value is inferred.
rows.formula: 2023 incident cancer cases, all sites / 2023 annual PEP population * 100000 (crude; not age-adjusted)

rows.label: New HIV diagnoses per 100,000 residents

limitations: Retained local prepared observations are provisional 2024 diagnoses among age 13+ reported through Dec 2025; 12-month reporting delay. Use age-13+ same-year PEP population for a crude rate.
